description: This file defines a class 'GetSystemStatusRequest' which extends 'Request' to encapsulate a request for system status information in a mock Zigbee core environment. It creates an inner Response class with methods to access various network status details, and executes by sending this response.

classes.name: GetSystemStatusRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to retrieve system status information in the mock Zigbee core environment. It extends 'Request' and overrides execute to send a response with network status details.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Overrides the execute method to create and send a response containing network status information, including network state flags, EUI64 identifiers, channel, PAN ID, and network key.
